title: Brown-Séquard and the Cord Syndromes: Which Side Is Weak, Which Side Is Numb?

hook.en: A half-cut spinal cord leaves one leg weak and the OTHER leg unable to feel pain. Damage the cord yourself in the lab, then read the body like an expert.
hook.ur: Aadha kata hua spinal cord ek taang ko kamzor aur DOOSRI taang ko dard na mehsoos karne wala bana deta hai. Lab mein khud cord ko kharab karein, phir jism ko expert ki tarah parhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll name Brown-Séquard, anterior, central and posterior cord syndromes from the findings, predict which side loses strength, position sense and pain, and plan safe first physiotherapy steps.
goal.ur: End tak aap findings se Brown-Séquard, anterior, central aur posterior cord syndromes ke naam batayenge, andaza lagayenge ke kaunsi side taqat, position sense aur dard khoti hai, aur physiotherapy ke mehfooz pehle qadam plan karenge.

text.en: A cross-section of the cord has just **three tracts** you must know. The **lateral corticospinal tract** carries voluntary strength down; it already crossed in the medulla, so it controls the SAME side. The **dorsal columns** carry position, vibration and fine touch up; they stay on the SAME side until the medulla. The **spinothalamic tract** carries pain and temperature up; it crosses within one or two segments of where it enters, so a cord lesion hits the OPPOSITE side.
text.ur: Cord ke cross-section mein sirf **teen tracts** yaad rakhne hain. **Lateral corticospinal tract** iradi taqat neeche laata hai; yeh medulla mein pehle hi cross ho chuka, is liye SAME side ko control karta hai. **Dorsal columns** position, vibration aur fine touch upar le jate hain; yeh medulla tak SAME side par rehte hain. **Spinothalamic tract** dard aur temperature upar le jata hai; yeh dakhil hone ke ek do segments ke andar cross ho jata hai, is liye cord lesion ULTI side ko mutasir karta hai.

text.en: Picture a **three-lane cable bundle running up a building**. Two cables (strength and position sense) stay on the left side all the way, while the third (pain and temperature) swaps to the right side of the building after the first floor. Cut the left half of the bundle at floor 10 and you lose the two left-hand cables below floor 10 AND the swapped cable that carries the RIGHT leg's pain signals.
text.ur: **Imarat mein oopar jati teen cables ka bundle** tasawwur karein. Do cables (taqat aur position sense) poora raasta left side par rehti hain, jabke teesri (dard aur temperature) pehli manzil ke baad imarat ki right side par badal jati hai. Bundle ka left half 10vi manzil par kaat dein to 10vi manzil ke neeche left ki do cables jati hain AUR woh badli hui cable bhi jo RIGHT taang ke dard ke signals laati hai.

intro.en: Here is the cross-section. Tap a tract to damage it, or pick a syndrome. Watch the body map: red is weakness, the dashed blue outline is lost sensation. Start with the right hemisection (Brown-Séquard) and notice that the RIGHT leg is weak while the LEFT leg cannot feel pinprick.
intro.ur: Yeh cross-section hai. Kisi tract par tap kar ke kharab karein, ya syndrome chunein. Body map dekhein: laal rang kamzori hai, neeli dashed lakeer sensation ki kami. Right hemisection (Brown-Séquard) se shuru karein aur dekhein ke RIGHT taang kamzor hai jabke LEFT taang pinprick mehsoos nahi karti.

question.en: A stab wound halves the RIGHT side of the cord at T10. What do you expect on examination?
question.ur: T10 par cord ke RIGHT hisse ko ek chaaqu ka zakhm aadha kaat deta hai. Examination par kya expect karenge?

text.en: Both legs weak, all sensation lost on both sides
text.ur: Dono taangein kamzor, dono taraf har sensation ghayab

feedback.en: That is a complete lesion. A half-cut cord leaves the other half working.
feedback.ur: Yeh complete lesion hai. Aadha kata cord doosre hisse ko chalta rehne deta hai.

text.en: Right leg weak with lost position and vibration sense; left leg lost pain and temperature
text.ur: Right taang kamzor aur position aur vibration sense ghayab; left taang mein dard aur temperature ghayab

feedback.en: Yes — strength and position sense stay on the lesion side, while pain and temperature have crossed, so they are lost on the opposite side.
feedback.ur: Haan — taqat aur position sense lesion ki side par rehte hain, jabke dard aur temperature cross ho chuke, is liye ulti side par ghayab hote hain.

text.en: Left leg weak with lost pain on the right
text.ur: Left taang kamzor aur right par dard ghayab

feedback.en: The weakness follows the lesion side (right), not the opposite side, because the corticospinal tract has already crossed.
feedback.ur: Kamzori lesion ki side (right) ko follow karti hai, ulti nahi, kyunke corticospinal tract pehle hi cross ho chuka.

hint.en: Strength and position sense stay on the lesion side; pain and temperature cross.
hint.ur: Taqat aur position sense lesion ki side par; dard aur temperature cross.

text.en: **"Power and position stay; pain and temperature cross."** Everything about Brown-Séquard follows from this sentence: weakness and lost position sense on the SAME side as the lesion, lost pain and temperature on the OPPOSITE side, starting one or two levels below.
text.ur: **"Taqat aur position rehte hain; dard aur temperature cross."** Brown-Séquard ki har baat is jumlay se nikalti hai: kamzori aur position sense ki kami lesion ki SAME side, dard aur temperature ki kami ULTI side, ek do level neeche se shuru.

rows.en: Same-side weakness and lost position sense; opposite-side lost pain and temperature
rows.ur: Usi side kamzori aur position sense ghayab; ulti side dard aur temperature ghayab

rows.en: Stab wounds, tumours, some fractures and disc injuries; a pure form is rare, a partial form is common
rows.ur: Chaaqu ke zakhm, tumours, kuch fractures aur disc injuries; khalis shakal kam, adhoori shakal aam

rows.en: Both sides: weakness and lost pain and temperature below the lesion; position and vibration kept
rows.ur: Dono taraf: lesion ke neeche kamzori aur dard temperature ghayab; position aur vibration bacha rehta hai

rows.en: Anterior spinal artery stroke or a flexion injury; the dorsal columns are fed by a different artery
rows.ur: Anterior spinal artery ka stroke ya flexion injury; dorsal columns ko doosri artery khoon deti hai

rows.en: ARMS weaker than LEGS, cape-like loss of pain and temperature over the shoulders, bladder trouble
rows.ur: BAZOO TAANGON se zyada kamzor, kandhon par cape jaisa dard temperature ghayab, bladder ka masla

rows.en: An older person with a stiff neck who falls with the neck extended (cervical spondylosis)
rows.ur: Akri hui gardan wala buzurg jo gardan extend hone ke saath girta hai (cervical spondylosis)

rows.en: Both sides: lost position and vibration, normal strength, a stamping, wide-based sensory ataxia worse with eyes closed
rows.ur: Dono taraf: position aur vibration ghayab, taqat normal, patakhti chauri sensory ataxia jo aankhein band karne par bigarti hai

rows.en: B12 deficiency, tabes, some tumours; Romberg positive
rows.ur: B12 ki kami, tabes, kuch tumours; Romberg positive

question.en: An 70-year-old with cervical spondylosis falls forward and lands on her chin. She cannot lift her arms well, her legs are stronger, her hands burn and she has trouble with her bladder. Which syndrome?
question.ur: Cervical spondylosis wali 70 saal ki khatoon aage girti hai aur thori par lagti hai. Woh bazoo theek se utha nahi sakti, taangein zyada mazboot hain, haath jalte hain aur bladder mein masla hai. Kaunsa syndrome?

text.en: Brown-Séquard syndrome
text.ur: Brown-Séquard syndrome

feedback.en: That would give a clear side-to-side pattern, not arms worse than legs on both sides.
feedback.ur: Isme side-to-side saaf pattern hota, dono taraf bazoo taangon se zyada kamzor nahi.

text.en: Central cord syndrome
text.ur: Central cord syndrome

feedback.en: Yes — arms worse than legs with burning hands and bladder trouble is the classic central cord picture. The arm fibres sit more medially in the corticospinal tract, closer to the damaged centre.
feedback.ur: Haan — bazoo taangon se zyada kamzor, haathon mein jalan aur bladder ka masla central cord ki classic tasveer hai. Bazoo ke fibres corticospinal tract mein zyada andar (medial) hote hain, jo kharab darmiyan ke qareeb hain.

text.en: Posterior cord syndrome
text.ur: Posterior cord syndrome

feedback.en: Posterior cord loses position sense with normal strength. Here strength is clearly reduced.
feedback.ur: Posterior cord mein position sense jata hai aur taqat normal rehti hai. Yahan taqat saaf kam hai.

prompt.en: Which side of the body? Sort each finding for a RIGHT-sided cord lesion.
prompt.ur: Jism ki kaunsi side? Right-sided cord lesion ke liye har finding ko sort karein.

text.en: Weakness below the lesion
text.ur: Lesion ke neeche kamzori

why.en: The corticospinal tract has already crossed in the medulla, so a cord lesion weakens the same side.
why.ur: Corticospinal tract medulla mein pehle hi cross ho chuka, is liye cord lesion usi side ko kamzor karta hai.

text.en: Loss of position and vibration sense
text.ur: Position aur vibration sense ki kami

why.en: The dorsal columns stay uncrossed until the medulla.
why.ur: Dorsal columns medulla tak uncrossed rehte hain.

text.en: Loss of pain and temperature
text.ur: Dard aur temperature ki kami

why.en: The spinothalamic tract crosses within one or two segments, so it is lost on the opposite side.
why.ur: Spinothalamic tract ek do segments ke andar cross hota hai, is liye ulti side par ghayab hota hai.

text.en: Brisk reflexes and an upgoing plantar
text.ur: Brisk reflexes aur upar jata plantar

why.en: Upper motor neuron signs follow the damaged corticospinal tract, on the same side.
why.ur: Upper motor neuron signs kharab corticospinal tract ko usi side par follow karte hain.

text.en: **Calling the weak leg the "opposite" side.** In the brain a stroke on the left weakens the right, so students carry that rule into the cord and get Brown-Séquard backwards. In the cord the corticospinal tract has already crossed, so weakness is on the SAME side. The other trap: assuming the sensory level is exactly at the lesion. Pain and temperature loss usually begins one or two segments below, because the fibres rise a little before they cross.
text.ur: **Kamzor taang ko "ulti" side kehna.** Dimagh mein left stroke right ko kamzor karta hai, is liye students yeh usool cord mein bhi le aate hain aur Brown-Séquard ulta kar dete hain. Cord mein corticospinal tract pehle hi cross ho chuka, is liye kamzori SAME side hoti hai. Doosra jaal: yeh samajhna ke sensory level bilkul lesion par hota hai. Dard aur temperature ki kami aksar ek do segments neeche se shuru hoti hai, kyunke fibres cross hone se pehle thora upar chadhte hain.

text.en: **Write the pattern, then the level.** "Right-sided weakness 3/5 hip flexion down, right position sense lost, left pinprick lost from T12 down: a Brown-Séquard pattern, probable level T10-T11." Test pinprick and temperature with a safety pin and a cool object, and test position sense on the big toe before you decide anything. If the story is new and progressive (cancer history, trauma, fever, bladder change), the cord is an emergency, not a case for routine treatment.
text.ur: **Pehle pattern likhein, phir level.** "Right taraf kamzori hip flexion se neeche 3/5, right position sense ghayab, left pinprick T12 se neeche ghayab: Brown-Séquard pattern, mumkin level T10-T11." Koi faisla karne se pehle safety pin aur thandi cheez se pinprick aur temperature, aur bare angootha par position sense test karein. Agar kahani nayi aur barhti hui hai (cancer ki history, trauma, bukhar, bladder ki tabdeeli) to cord emergency hai, aam ilaaj ka case nahi.

title.en: First physiotherapy steps after a partial cord lesion (once the medical team says the spine is stable)
title.ur: Partial cord lesion ke baad physiotherapy ke pehle qadam (jab medical team kahe ke reerh mehfooz hai)

steps.title: Respect spinal precautions first
steps.detail: Ask the team for the spinal stability status and any movement limits before you handle the patient. || Pehle spinal precautions

steps.title: Map both sides separately
steps.detail: Record motor power by myotome and sensation by dermatome for the right and left. They will not match, and that is the whole point. || Dono sides alag naapein

steps.title: Protect the side that cannot feel pain
steps.detail: The leg that cannot feel pain or temperature burns or pressure-injures without warning: check the skin daily and avoid hot packs there. || Jo side dard nahi mehsoos karti usay bachayein

steps.title: Train the strong leg to help the weak one
steps.detail: Task-specific stepping, weight-shift and strengthening on the weak side; use the intact limb for balance and the walking aid on the side that has position sense. || Mazboot taang ko kamzor ki madad karna sikhayein

steps.title: Teach the patient to look
steps.detail: With lost position sense on one side, the patient must watch the foot (mirror or direct view) while stepping, and is at higher risk of falls in the dark. || Mareez ko dekhna sikhayein

text.en: Pure Brown-Séquard syndrome is rare; most people have a partial picture (a **Brown-Séquard-plus** pattern). The prognosis for walking is generally better than for other incomplete cord syndromes: in published series most people with Brown-Séquard-type injuries regain the ability to walk, especially if they are young and some motor function remains in the first weeks. The ASIA Impairment Scale and the International Standards for Neurological Classification (ISNCSCI) are how clinicians grade and track a cord injury.
text.ur: Khalis Brown-Séquard syndrome kam milta hai; zyada tar logon mein adhoori tasveer (**Brown-Séquard-plus** pattern) hoti hai. Chalne ka prognosis aam taur par doosre incomplete cord syndromes se behtar hai: chhapi hui series mein Brown-Séquard type injury wale zyada tar log dobara chalne lagte hain, khaas kar jawan aur woh jin mein pehle hafton mein kuch motor function bacha ho. ASIA Impairment Scale aur International Standards for Neurological Classification (ISNCSCI) woh tareeqe hain jin se clinicians cord injury ko grade aur track karte hain.

text.en: **Treat as an emergency, not a routine case:** a new cord syndrome with bladder or bowel change, a rapidly worsening deficit, back pain with a cancer history, fever or after trauma. Do not mobilise or manipulate the spine and arrange immediate medical review. In a known cord injury, watch for **autonomic dysreflexia** (T6 and above): a sudden headache, flushing and a very high blood pressure from a trigger such as a full bladder. Sit the patient up, loosen clothing, and call for help at once.
text.ur: **Emergency samjhein, aam case nahi:** naya cord syndrome jis ke saath bladder ya bowel ki tabdeeli ho, tezi se barhta hua nuqs, cancer ki history ke saath kamar dard, bukhar, ya trauma ke baad. Reerh ko mobilise ya manipulate na karein aur foran medical review karwayein. Maloom cord injury mein **autonomic dysreflexia** (T6 aur upar) se hoshyar rahein: achanak sar dard, chehra laal aur bohat unchi blood pressure, jis ki wajah bhara hua bladder jaisi koi cheez ho sakti hai. Mareez ko baitha dein, kapray dheelay karein aur foran madad bulayein.

question.en: A patient with a known T4 cord injury suddenly develops a pounding headache, flushing above the lesion and a blood pressure of 190/110. What is the first move?
question.ur: T4 cord injury wale maloom mareez ko achanak dhamaake wala sar dard, lesion se upar chehra laal aur blood pressure 190/110 ho jata hai. Pehla qadam kya hai?

text.en: Lie the patient flat and continue the exercise session
text.ur: Mareez ko seedha litayein aur exercise session jaari rakhein

feedback.en: Lying flat raises the head blood pressure further and exercise adds to it. Sit them up and stop.
feedback.ur: Seedha litane se sar ka blood pressure mazeed barhta hai aur exercise us mein izafa karti hai. Baithayein aur ruk jayein.

text.en: Give a hot pack to relax the muscles
text.ur: Muscles dheelay karne ke liye garam pack dein

feedback.en: Heat on a body that cannot sense it can burn, and it does nothing for the trigger.
feedback.ur: Jo jism mehsoos nahi kar sakta us par garmi jala sakti hai aur trigger par koi asar nahi.

text.en: Sit the patient up, loosen tight clothing and call for urgent help to find the trigger (often the bladder or bowel)
text.ur: Mareez ko baitha dein, tang kapray dheelay karein aur trigger (aksar bladder ya bowel) dhoondne ke liye foran madad bulayein

feedback.en: Yes — this is autonomic dysreflexia, a medical emergency. Sitting up lowers the pressure, and clearing the trigger stops it.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh autonomic dysreflexia hai, medical emergency. Baithne se pressure kam hota hai aur trigger door karne se ruk jata hai.

question.en: Why does a posterior (dorsal column) lesion make a patient stamp their feet and fall when they close their eyes?
question.ur: Posterior (dorsal column) lesion mein mareez paaon patakhta hai aur aankhein band karne par kyun girta hai?

answer.en: Balance uses three inputs: vision, the vestibular system and **position sense (proprioception)**. If the dorsal columns are damaged, position sense is lost, so the patient leans on vision. Close the eyes and one of the three remaining inputs vanishes; they sway or fall (**a positive Romberg**). The stamping gait is the patient trying to make the foot "feel" the ground harder.
answer.ur: Balance teen inputs istemal karta hai: nazar, vestibular system aur **position sense (proprioception)**. Dorsal columns kharab hon to position sense chala jata hai, is liye mareez nazar par tikta hai. Aankhein band karein to baaqi teen mein se ek input ghayab; woh jhoolta ya girta hai (**positive Romberg**). Patakhti chaal mareez ki koshish hai ke paaon zameen ko zyada "mehsoos" kare.

summary.en: The cord holds three tracts: corticospinal (strength, SAME side), dorsal columns (position and vibration, SAME side), spinothalamic (pain and temperature, OPPOSITE side).
summary.ur: Cord mein teen tracts hain: corticospinal (taqat, SAME side), dorsal columns (position aur vibration, SAME side), spinothalamic (dard aur temperature, ULTI side).

summary.en: Brown-Séquard = same-side weakness and lost position sense, opposite-side lost pain and temperature; anterior = lost motor and pain with position kept; central = arms worse than legs; posterior = position lost, strength normal.
summary.ur: Brown-Séquard = usi side kamzori aur position sense ghayab, ulti side dard aur temperature ghayab; anterior = motor aur dard ghayab, position bacha; central = bazoo taangon se zyada; posterior = position ghayab, taqat normal.

summary.en: Protect the numb side from burns and pressure, respect spinal precautions, and treat a new or worsening cord picture, or autonomic dysreflexia, as an emergency.
summary.ur: Sunn side ko jalne aur pressure se bachayein, spinal precautions ka khayal rakhein, aur naye ya barhte cord picture ya autonomic dysreflexia ko emergency samjhein.

front.en: Which tract crosses in the medulla, and which crosses within the cord?
front.ur: Kaunsa tract medulla mein cross hota hai aur kaunsa cord ke andar?

back.en: Corticospinal crosses in the medulla; the spinothalamic crosses within one or two cord segments of entry. The dorsal columns cross in the medulla.
back.ur: Corticospinal medulla mein cross hota hai; spinothalamic dakhil hone ke ek do cord segments ke andar. Dorsal columns medulla mein cross hotay hain.

back.en: A half-cut cord: SAME-side weakness and lost position sense, OPPOSITE-side lost pain and temperature, starting a few segments below.
back.ur: Aadha kata cord: SAME side kamzori aur position sense ghayab, ULTI side dard aur temperature ghayab, kuch segments neeche se shuru.

front.en: Which cord syndrome spares position sense but loses pain and strength?
front.ur: Kaunsa cord syndrome position sense bachata hai magar dard aur taqat ghayab karta hai?

back.en: Anterior cord syndrome: the dorsal columns have a separate blood supply, so they are spared.
back.ur: Anterior cord syndrome: dorsal columns ko alag khoon ki supply hoti hai, is liye woh bach jate hain.

front.en: Which cord syndrome affects the arms more than the legs?
front.ur: Kaunsa cord syndrome bazooon ko taangon se zyada mutasir karta hai?

back.en: Central cord syndrome, typically an older person falling with a hyperextended, spondylotic neck.
back.ur: Central cord syndrome, aam taur par spondylotic gardan wala buzurg jo gardan ke hyperextend hone ke saath girta hai.

front.en: What is autonomic dysreflexia and the first response?
front.ur: Autonomic dysreflexia kya hai aur pehla jawab?

back.en: A sudden blood-pressure surge in a cord injury at T6 or above (headache, flushing). Sit the patient up, loosen clothing, remove the trigger and call for help.
back.ur: T6 ya upar cord injury mein blood pressure ka achanak barhna (sar dard, chehra laal). Mareez ko baithayein, kapray dheelay karein, trigger door karein aur madad bulayein.
